item.text: The campaign is live with both approved posts, each starting at US$45 per day and a US$225 flight cap. Targeting is iPhone only, worldwide except Russia and Belarus, with no language restriction. It will stop at midnight after February 14 in Auckland (February 14, 11:00 UTC). I’ll compare delivery and link-click costs as it runs; those figures cannot establish which post produces more installs.

The first Auckland day has recorded US$84.85 in spend and 125 link clicks. The Valentine’s post has a slightly lower cost per click, but the difference is small. I’m keeping the split even while more data comes in.

After two days, the Valentine’s post is averaging about US$0.66 per link click versus US$0.72 for the window post. I’m shifting a modest share of the remaining budget toward the Valentine’s post as the deadline approaches, keeping both running and the combined flight cap at US$450.

item.text: Three days in, the campaign has recorded US$267.14 in spend and 407 link clicks. The Valentine’s post continues to bring lower-cost clicks, averaging US$0.62 versus US$0.71. The revised budget split is pacing close to the planned total, so I’m keeping it for now.

The final Auckland day is starting with US$360.06 spent and 558 link clicks recorded. About US$89.94 remains under the combined cap. Both posts are still running, with more budget on the Valentine’s message, and both are scheduled to stop when the offer ends tonight.
The campaign has reached its scheduled end and X confirms it is no longer serving. I’ve also paused it. I’ll allow one hour for reporting to catch up, then collect the closing activity totals.

The campaign ran February 10–14 in Auckland time and stopped with the offer deadline.

X-reported campaign activity:

- Spend: **US$445.08** of US$450
- Impressions: **1,062,840**
- Link clicks: **704**
- Average cost per link click: **US$0.63**

I monitored the flight and shifted budget toward the Valentine’s post as it delivered cheaper clicks. Only your two approved posts ran, targeting iPhones worldwide except Russia and Belarus.

Completed first-time installs remain the outcome to assess using your own records; X did not measure them.
